description: This file defines a final class 'Converters' that acts as a factory and repository for converter instances, handling the registration, lookup, and creation of converters for different data types within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes mechanisms for dynamic loading, caching, and extension via converter creators and loaders.

classes.name: Converters
classes.description: A factory and repository class managing converter instances, including registration, lookup, and dynamic loading.

classes.name: Converters.PassThruConverterCreator
classes.description: A nested class that creates pass-through converters when source and target types are compatible.

classes.name: Converters.PassThruConverter
classes.description: A nested class implementing a converter that returns the source object when source and target types are the same.

methods.name: getConverter
methods.description: Returns a converter instance suitable for converting between the specified source and target classes.

methods.name: loadContainedConverters
methods.description: Loads and initializes converters contained within a specified class.

methods.name: registerCreator
methods.description: Registers a converter creator to be used when a matching converter isn't found.

methods.name: registerConverter
methods.description: Registers a new converter instance for specified source and target classes.
